headline: Nakul Markhedkar Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations - Vikran Engineering
sum: Nakul Markhedkar has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding substantial acquisition of shares in Vikran Engineering Limited. The substantive deal terms, consideration, and shareholding details are not disclosed in the search excerpt.
detail: The disclosure is filed under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, which requires acquirers to announce to the exchange and public within 48 hours of crossing the 5% shareholding threshold or upon intent to acquire control. No details on acquisition method (open market, creeping acquisition, negotiated), share count, price per share, or total consideration are available in publicly indexed sources.
